png-to-jpg.title: Convert PNG to JPG Online (High Fidelity & Secure) – Fluxora
png-to-jpg.description: Convert PNG to JPG instantly with no file upload. Technical details: Canvas API based, adjustable quality, client-side security. The safest way to convert images.
png-to-jpg.content:
Experience the fastest and most secure way to convert PNG images to JPG format. Unlike traditional converters that require you to upload your sensitive files to a remote server, Fluxora performs the entire conversion process locally within your web browser using advanced HTML5 Canvas technology.

What is PNG?

PNG (Portable Network Graphics) is a raster-graphics file-format that supports lossless data compression. It allows for transparency (alpha channel), making it ideal for web graphics, logos, and overlays.

What is JPG?

JPG (or JPEG) is a commonly used method of lossy compression for digital images, particularly for those images produced by digital photography. The degree of compression can be adjusted, allowing a selectable tradeoff between storage size and image quality.

Why convert PNG to JPG?

While PNGs are great for quality, they can be large in file size. Converting to JPG significantly reduces the file size, making it easier to share via email, upload to websites, or store on devices with limited capacity.

Technical Specifications

Input FormatPNG (Portable Network Graphics)
Output FormatJPG (Joint Photographic Experts Group)
Processing TypeClient-Side (Browser)
SecurityEnd-to-End Encryption (Local)
Max File SizeUnlimited (Depends on RAM)

How it Works

  1. Import: The browser reads your file into local memory.
  2. Decoding: The image data is decoded onto a virtual canvas.
  3. Encoding: The canvas data is re-encoded using the JPEG algorithm.
  4. Export: A new Blob object is created and served for download.
  5. Cleanup: Memory is immediately freed after download.

png-to-jpg.faq_a1: Since we process files on your device, the only limit is your device's available RAM. You can typically convert files up to several hundred megabytes.
png-to-jpg.faq_q2: Does this tool support batch conversion?
png-to-jpg.faq_a2: Currently, we focus on single-file precision, but batch processing features are in development.
png-to-jpg.faq_a3: Yes! Because your files never leave your computer (no server upload), this is the safest method for handling sensitive documents.

jpg-to-png.title: Convert JPG to PNG Online (Lossless Output) – Fluxora
jpg-to-png.description: Convert JPG images to PNG format. Recover quality potential and prepare for editing. Secure, local, and free.
jpg-to-png.content:
Transform your compressed JPG images into the lossless PNG format. ideal for further editing, archiving, or when you need to ensure no further quality loss occurs during saving.

Understanding the Formats

JPG uses lossy compression, meaning it discards some data to save space. PNG is lossless, retaining all image data. Converting JPG to PNG stops the degradation cycle of repeated JPG saves.

Technical Comparison

FeatureJPGPNG
CompressionLossyLossless
TransparencyNoYes
Best ForPhotosGraphics/Text
jpg-to-png.faq_q1: Will converting JPG to PNG improve quality?
jpg-to-png.faq_a1: It will not magically restore lost details from the original compression, but it prevents *further* quality loss when you edit and save the file again.
jpg-to-png.faq_a2: Yes, PNG files are typically larger because they store more data to maintain lossless quality.

pdf-to-txt.content:
Extracting text from PDFs can be a privacy nightmare with online tools. Fluxora changes that. We use a JavaScript-based PDF parsing engine to read your document directly in your browser tab.

How it Works

The PDF structure is complex, containing vector instructions, fonts, and metadata. Our tool parses this binary stream, locates text objects, and maps them to Unicode characters, outputting a clean TXT file.

  • Editing: Quickly get the content out of a 'read-only' format.

png-to-avif.title: Convert PNG to AVIF (Next-Gen Web Format) – Fluxora
png-to-avif.description: Convert PNG to AVIF. AVIF offers superior compression and quality compared to webp and jpg.
png-to-avif.content:
AVIF (AV1 Image File Format) is the latest revolution in image compression. It offers up to 50% smaller file sizes than JPEG with better quality.

Technical Deep Dive

AVIF uses the AV1 video codec for image sequences. It supports:

  • High Dynamic Range (HDR)
  • Wide Color Gamut (WCG)
  • Transparency and overlays
  • Lossy and Lossless compression

internet-speed-test.content:
Understand your connection quality. Our speed test effectively saturates your bandwidth to find the true maximum capacity.

Definitions

  • Download Speed: How fast data comes from the internet to you.
  • Upload Speed: How fast you send data to the internet.
  • Ping (Latency): The reaction time of your connection.
  • Jitter: The variability in ping over time (important for gaming).

privacy.content:
Privacy Policy

Effective Date: January 2025

This policy describes how Fluxora handles your data.

1. No File Uploads

We do not have servers to receive your files. When you 'import' a file into Fluxora, it stays in your browser's memory sandbox.

2. Local Storage

We use LocalStorage only to save user preferences (like theme or language). We do not use it to track you.

3. External Services

We may use third-party CDNs (like Cloudflare or Vercel) to deliver the website code. These providers may see your IP address as part of standard internet connectivity, but they cannot see the files you convert.
